name: reduced hex, ring base, steel
source: NASM21042 'NUT, SELF-LOCKING, 450 F, REDUCED HEXAGON, REDUCED HEIGHT, RING BASE, NON-CORROSION RESISTANT STEEL', Table I, Rev 4 (2026-06-30), dash 6, procurement spec NASM25027. height = H MAX, bearingDiameter = OB MIN, ratedUltimateLoad = AXIAL STRENGTH LBF MIN (160 ksi steel basis). ESSENTIAL USAGE ADVISORY (spec sheet 2): susceptible to hydrogen assisted cracking (embrittlement / stress corrosion cracking); per NASM33588 -- cited by NASA-STD-5020B Appendix B.4.2.1d -- these nuts 'shall not be used ... where loss of the bolt would affect safety of flight.' material="Steel" is a stand-in for the spec's non-corrosion-resistant alloy steel, chosen deliberately: the library's "Steel" entry (150 ksi Ftu / 86603 psi Fsu, Fsy=Fty/sqrt3) is the only non-CRES steel material in the library and understates this spec's 160 ksi basis, so using it for the computed thread-shear check is CONSERVATIVE (lower allowable), not unconservative. Replace with a matched NASM25027 alloy entry when one is added to the library.
